paragraphs.text: Arna Kennerüd was a prominent Kjeldoran skyknight during the during the Ice Age of Dominaria . By the time of the Thaw , she was promoted to skycaptain.
Arna was a skyknight during the Ice Age. She had a son who spent four years as a Shield Bearer before likely becoming a skyknight himself.
By 4562 AR, her descendant Tura Kennerüd also serves as a skyknight, riding an aesthir that is directly descended from Arna's.
Arna was named after the then-boyfriend and later husband of Darla Kennerud , who was in charge of flavor text during Ice Age .
